name: TerraeMC
description:
Looking for a Minecraft server that offers a unique and exciting survival experience on both Bedrock and Java editions?

Look no further than TerraeMC! Our server boasts a Towny system that allows you to form your own town, join a nation and conquer the earth alongside other players.

We run on Minecraft version 1.19 - 1.20.1 and are compatible with both Bedrock and Java editions. Our bedrock port is 19132.

Visit our website at http://terraemc.net for more information and join our friendly and active Discord community at https://discord.gg/CQ2DYwH.

Join TerraeMC today and start your adventure!
